localChanges: A citizen you take off a tile on the city map now becomes an Entertainer, who makes 2 luxuries, instead of doing nothing. Click an Entertainer in the city's citizen row to make them a Tax collector (2 gold), click again for a Scientist (2 science), and again to go back to an Entertainer. Click an unworked tile to put one back to work (closes #84).
A Marketplace and a Bank raise what Entertainers and Tax collectors make to 3 and then 4. A Library and a University do the same for Scientists.

When a city has no tile left to work, or has grown past size 20, its new citizens are born as Entertainers. A city keeps its specialists when it grows or rearranges its workers, and loses them first when it shrinks.
